sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Identifies this instruction-tuned model; declares 32.5B total and 31.0B non-embedding parameters. Advertises 131,072 tokens with YaRN configuration instructions.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct config.json
sources.evidence: Qwen2ForCausalLM with 64 layers, hidden size 5120, intermediate size 27648, 40 query heads, 8 KV heads, untied embeddings and vocabulary 152064. max_position_embeddings is 32768; no rope_scaling is present.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder Series: Powerful, Diverse, Practical.
sources.evidence: November 12, 2024 announcement explicitly releases the 32B Instruct variant and discusses code generation, repair and execution reasoning. Table declares 32.5B parameters and Apache 2.0 licensing.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct tokenizer_config.json
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint chat template supports tool definitions, named JSON function calls, tool responses and ordinary text chat. Default system text attributes Qwen to Alibaba Cloud.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct LICENSE
sources.evidence: The repository distributes the Apache License, Version 2.0.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository files

sources.title: Hugging Face metadata for the official Qwen checkpoint
sources.publisher: Hugging Face, for Qwen official repository
sources.evidence: At revision 381fc969f78efac66bc87ff7ddeadb7e73c218a7, safetensors.parameters.BF16 and safetensors.total both equal 32763876352. Repository creation timestamp is November 6, distinct from public launch.

sources.title: Official safetensors checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Metadata total_size is 65527752704 bytes, consistent with 32763876352 BF16 parameters. Lists 771 tensors with dense attention and MLP projections; no expert or router tensors.

sources.title: Models.dev upstream catalog record
sources.evidence: Baseline provenance: records November 12 release, 131072 context, text input/output, tools supported and reasoning unsupported. Used as a lead rather than technical verification.

name.note: Matches the exact official checkpoint title.

developer.note: Alibaba is the catalog parent-company normalization of the template attribution to Alibaba Cloud.

family.note: Qwen2.5-Coder is explicitly a Qwen model series; qwen preserves catalog family granularity.

release_date.note: Dated developer announcement explicitly introduces this 32B Instruct release. Repository creation on November 6 is not public-release evidence.

open_weights.note: Official model weights are publicly available as safetensors shards.

license.note: Exact repository license and official announcement agree.

parameters_b.note: Exact published-checkpoint tensor count is 32,763,876,352. The official card declares 32.5B, which is not an exact tensor count and differs from the metadata; 32B is nominal branding. BF16 index bytes divided by two corroborate the metadata. Config dimensions independently reproduce the total including untied input/output embeddings, norms and attention biases.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate active-per-token count is published. Dense architecture does not justify copying the total; 31.0B non-embedding parameters are not an active count.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only transformer, inferred from Qwen2ForCausalLM config and per-layer attention/MLP checkpoint tensors, without routed experts. Uses GQA; the card specifies RoPE, SwiGLU and RMSNorm.

context_window.note: Supported extended limit, not the default configuration: 32768 positions by default; the card instructs adding YaRN factor 4 with original_max_position_embeddings 32768 for long inputs.

modalities.note: Causal text generation with a text-chat tokenizer/template; configuration has no multimodal encoder. Shared tokenizer vision-token strings do not establish image support.

reasoning.note: Official sources discuss code reasoning ability but do not explicitly establish the catalog capability flag for a dedicated reasoning/thinking mode on this exact variant. Standard chat-template absence alone is insufficient to verify false.

tool_call.note: Exact checkpoint template accepts function schemas and serializes assistant tool calls and tool responses; this supports tool-call formatting, not a quality guarantee.

description.value: Open-weight instruction-tuned Qwen coding model for code generation, repair, and code reasoning.
description.note: Developer announcement supports these capabilities. Replaces the baseline repository-reasoning claim with the narrower explicitly documented code-reasoning claim.

patch.description: Open-weight instruction-tuned Qwen coding model for code generation, repair, and code reasoning.
patch.notes: 32B is nominal branding. The official card declares 32.5B; official checkpoint metadata reports 32,763,876,352 parameters. Active parameters are not separately reported. Context is 32,768 tokens by default, extended to 131,072 with the documented YaRN factor-4 configuration. Dedicated reasoning-mode status remains unverified.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for the exact variant. Correct nominal 32B to the verified 32.763876352B checkpoint count while preserving the discrepant 32.5B card declaration; fill Apache-2.0 and dense architecture; narrow the description. Confirm November 12 release, public weights, text modalities, template-supported tool calls and configurable 131072 context. Active count remains undisclosed and dedicated reasoning-mode status unverified.
